scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c green,cyan "npm run dev -w @mydryfruits/api" "npm run dev -w @mydryfruits/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @mydryfruits/db && npm run build -w @mydryfruits/api && npm run build -w @mydryfruits/web
scripts.start: concurrently -n api,web -c green,cyan "npm run start -w @mydryfruits/api" "npm run start -w @mydryfruits/web"
